breakdown.description: The top load is extended onto the notch arc instead of being limited to the two shoulders
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The generated specification contains contradictory instructions. It correctly states to apply traction on the top edge segments `x ∈ [0, 0.45) ∪ (0.55, 1.0]` and that the notch arc is traction-free. However, it then adds a conflicting instruction: `Apply the same traction t = (0, -10 MPa·m) continuously on the top part of the semicircular notch arc that lies on the top boundary.` This re-introduces the original error from the incomplete prompt, whereas the ground truth specifies the load is *only* on the two top segments.
